# D–D coupling: exact even-wave zero and conditional nonzero sizes

**The leading boost gives exactly zero from either D–D s wave to any ⁴He $0^+$ state.** The odd entrance can contribute at first order; the first even path generated by this boost takes two insertions. The sizes below are matrix elements, not populations or foil rates.

### Selection and on-shell exits

[Hagelstein, Eq. 27 and Apps. D–F](https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6455/acf3be) give $V^{(1)}_{fi}=C_{fi}\cdot\mathbf P c$, $C_{fi}=i(E_f-E_i)O_{fi}/(2m_Nc^2M_4c^2)$, $O=\sum_j\boldsymbol\sigma_j\times(\boldsymbol\pi_jc)$, $M_4=4m_N$. This is a parity-odd, rank-one, isoscalar operator at equal mass: $0^+\leftrightarrow1^-$ with $T$ conserved between pure isospin states. Coulomb mixing can relax the $T$ rule, not rank or parity. Bose exchange requires $L+S$ even: both ${}^1S_0$ and ${}^5S_2$ give exact zero at each entrance energy; of ${}^3P_{0,1,2}$, only ${}^3P_1$ reaches $0^+$.

| Real $0^+$ destination | Ordinary particle exits at its energy |
|---|---|
| Bound ground state | Neither open; D–D capture must dispose of about 23.85 MeV. |
| [Evaluated 20.21 MeV resonance](https://nucldata.tunl.duke.edu/nucldata/HTML/A=4/04_03_1992.pdf) | $p+t$ open (19.814 MeV threshold), $n+{}^3\mathrm{He}$ closed (20.578 MeV); $\Gamma\approx0.50$ MeV. Real feeding requires removal of about 3.64 MeV. A virtual contribution at D–D energy does not inherit this closure. |
| [Inferred near-threshold pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.02112v3), around 23.847 MeV | Both exits open. The model 40-meV proton width, 115° interference phase and 0.2–0.3 eV total width with internal pair creation do not fix the neutron residue or p/n ratio. |

### Signed intrinsic witness and separate Coulomb entrance

The $M=0$ Cartesian witness uses antisymmetrized [NuHamil](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.07962) Jacobi states with bare [EM500 N³LO NN](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevC.68.041001), fixed $T=0$, and 28 MeV oscillator energy. For $N_{\max}=6$ (64 even/61 odd), the lowest $0^+\to1^-$ pair has gap 33.980 MeV and $C_z=-1.038\times10^{-3}i$ eV/eV of $Pc$. At 4 (20/12), $|C_z|=1.291\times10^{-3}$: enlarging the basis lowers it 20%. Switching off projected pp Coulomb at 6 changes it 0.70%; no alternative NN force was tested. The ground state underbinds, and excited eigenstates are not physical poles.

The 37-meV PdD two-mass reference has $\langle1|P_{\rm pair}c|0\rangle=i\sqrt{\hbar\omega/2}\sum_{a\in{\rm pair}}\sqrt{m_a c^2}\,e_a$ with signed mass-weighted $\sum_a|e_a|^2=1$. One moving D in one cell gives $Pc_0=5.836$ keV, $P/(M_4c)=1.554\times10^{-6}$ and **6.056 eV** odd mixing. A uniform $N$-cell mode divides each entry by $\sqrt N$; sum signed pair momenta first. The [archived cold pumped PdD comparison](../../g3_lattice/rerun/part2/updated/part2.md) at 41.62 meV has a spatial RMS of site peak $Pc=1.502$ keV per D ($P/(M_4c)=4.00\times10^{-7}$), giving **1.559 eV** peak odd mixing. This site statistic is not a common coherent amplitude; isolated-site thermal RMS is not mode momentum.

The separate frozen-D cluster model uses a Gaussian $0^+$ surrogate bound by a separable potential and repulsive Coulomb ${}^3P_1$ waves $u_E=\sqrt{2\mu/(\pi\hbar^2k)}F_1(\eta,kr)$, normalized to $\delta(E-E')$. It integrates the signed $C(E)e^{i\sigma_1}$, not an intensity, against a unit-normalized top hat. With $b=1.2$–2.0 fm, packet $|C|$ is $(5.59\text{–}12.4)\times10^{-22}$ eV/eV at 250 eV (25-eV band) and $(3.75\text{–}8.31)\times10^{-12}$ at 2.5 keV (250-eV band). The optical/driven mixing ranges, respectively, are $(3.26\text{–}7.23)\times10^{-18}$ / $(0.840\text{–}1.86)\times10^{-18}$ eV at 250 eV and $(2.19\text{–}4.85)\times10^{-8}$ / $(0.564\text{–}1.25)\times10^{-8}$ eV at 2.5 keV. Coulomb penetration is already included. Energy-normalized $C(E)$ is in $\mathrm{eV}^{-1/2}$; packet $C$ depends on bandwidth and phase. Neither coefficient supplies a rate without matching the incoming flux, nuclear channels and lattice response.

### First even path: ordered, off shell, not the full operator

For one collinear harmonic mode the term is $\sum_k(Pc)_{n_fk}(Pc)_{kn_i}K[(n_i-k)\hbar\omega]$, with $K(x)=\sum_r C_{fr}C_{ri}/(E_i-E_r+x+i0)$. The intermediate is $1^-,T=0$ in the isospin limit (including for $2^+\to0^+$); $\Delta n=0,\pm2$. The physical sum includes the odd continuum. The evaluated $T\simeq0$ 24.25-MeV $1^-$ centroid is about 0.40 MeV above D–D, with width 6.10 MeV: not a stable denominator.

Using the first excited and lowest even **basis** states as $i,f$ and the three archived odd states as $r$, the $N_{\max}=6$ Coulomb case gives $E_i-E_r=(+0.337,-25.593,-35.771)$ MeV and $K(0)=-9.083\times10^{-15}\ \mathrm{eV}^{-1}$. Its magnitude is $2.069\times10^{-14}$ at 4 with Coulomb and $9.176\times10^{-15}$ at 6 without. At $x=0$ the energy gap in $C_{ri}$ cancels the apparent small denominator. The 37-meV vacuum-to-two-phonon term is $-\sqrt2(Pc_0)^2K(-\hbar\omega)=+4.374\times10^{-7}$ eV, **off shell by 34.317 MeV**. The 41.62-meV sinusoidal reference gives $(Pc_{\rm pk}/2)^2K(-\hbar\omega)=-5.123\times10^{-9}$ eV in the two-quantum emission sideband, also off shell. On shell the only energy transfers in this kernel are $0,\pm2\hbar\omega$: at 37 meV the largest is 0.074 eV, not the basis gap, the MeV gaps in the table, or the 250–2500 eV distance from the nominal threshold pole in the packet examples. Nuclear widths alone do not supply the missing energy.

For a static collinear $\lambda=P/(M_4c)$, Eq. 27 is $i\lambda[H_N,B]$, $B=O_z/(2m_Nc^2)$. In the static boost completion $e^{-i\lambda B}H_Ne^{i\lambda B}$, the co-moving frame removes the term and the double-commutator contact cancels the diagonal shift $\lambda^2\sum_r(E_i-E_r)|B_{ri}|^2$. If $\lambda$ is a mode operator, removing the nuclear commutator leaves a first-order term $-i[H_{\rm lat},\lambda]B$. Thus two insertions of Eq. 27 alone are representation-dependent; the physical same-order operator is unknown.

**Three omissions:** matched multichannel D–D amplitudes and odd spectral phases; the consistent higher-order Hamiltonian; measured signed foil mode participation, occupation and loss. The [G12 readout](../../g12_residual/inputs_ledger.md) retains the fixed profiles and separate smooth Bosch–Hale p/n with 40-eV screening; these poles, widths and packets do not enter its denominator.

**Evidence:** [`collective_input.json`](collective_input.json) separates exact zero, physical unknowns and conditional inputs. The ordered sum uses the first three odd rows and first two even columns in the unchanged [`coupling_results.json`](coupling_results.json); no native rerun. Retained producer: [`replay.py`](replay.py), [`intrinsic.F90`](intrinsic.F90), [tool pins](../../tools_marvin/README.md). A new run would stamp the v2 input hash instead of the retained v1 hash.
